algorithm.title: Algorithm for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Patient With Gout.

cell.label: Patient presents with intensely painful, swollen joint in typical location. Past similar episodes. Gout likely using clinical decision rule?
Diagnosis in question; attempt joint aspiration. Positive gram stain and/or culture?
Patient refuses aspiration or unsuccessful in obtaining fluid. Consider colchicine trial for 1-2 d and assess response.
Obtain serum uric acid and, if elevated, treat with urate-lowering therapy.
Treat empirically with NSAIDs, steroids, or colchicine. Episode resolves?
MSU crystals confirm gout: treat with NSAIDs, steroids, or colchicine (above).
